[TOC]

### Prerequisites:
- The device and computer are on the same local area network (LAN), and the computer can ping the device's local IP address.
- Alternatively, the device has a WiFi module and can be switched to AP mode, allowing the computer to connect to the AP hotspot and access the address 192.168.42.100.

### Instructions
- Web network configuration is used to configure some network parameters of the device, such as 4G, WiFi, and the CMSV7 platform.

### Operation Steps:
1.Open your computer's browser and enter the device's local network IP address or AP hotspot address to access the web login interface. Enter the login password "Adm_123" and click "Login". To view the device's local network IP address, refer to the article "Function Usage" >>> "Network Functions"
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=20bf4f571655954ba109e9b1d3b92ad0)
2.Enter the username and password on the login page to access the settings page. Default username: admin, default password: Adm_123 3. Click on the settings page. Normal Settings >> Network Settings Enter the network settings interface
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=4a2baa06fb272112acf3df53f80019df)
3.On the settings page, click General Settings >> Network Settings to enter the network settings interface.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c64f9a9f1b8909ea4b642c057300acd4)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=2ab5ef87397933a6d06593244c5113ce)
4.On the network settings page, click the Platform Settings tab to configure the CMSV7 platform registration parameters on the private protocol
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=e38d16e119d7581a7f874b298cc91b71)
5.Click the Network Mode tab You can configure the device network mode (4G/WIFI/4G+WIFI mode/wired, 4G authentication type, GPS location transmission platform interval)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f5cfba5b940ba0c5ae3bb90791912ae6)
6.Click the GNet settings bar to configure 4G dial-up network type, access point, authentication username and password, and some dial-up parameters (the default settings are fine for domestic use; for overseas or VPN-specific IoT cards, please consult the SIM card manufacturer for these parameters).
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=e4fbfdc1f471773b490091bdb75c437e)
7.Click WiFi The settings panel allows you to configure parameters such as WiFi working mode, SSID name, password, security type, and automatic or fixed IP address configuration.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=35d7fe206e1b9cb223856b33a7f7cde3)
8.Clicking LAN settings allows you to configure the local wired network IP address, subnet mask, gateway, and MAC address.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=910cf2e46c6781ef894c2acdd23243c9)
9.Clicking the GB28181 settings panel allows you to configure parameters related to registering the GB28181 national standard protocol platform. 
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c73ff6fd7d14895cb3bd8a40f91195c8)
10.Clicking the 808 platform settings bar allows you to configure relevant parameters for registering the 808 Ministry Standard Protocol platform.
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d2d7b0b04c10aa5dfa9f3f283bc1e3b8)
